option_relations.rationale: The option directly matches the label of the leaf ID B1.1.
Infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma is a type of basal cell carcinoma that can be associated with Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC).

Basal cell nevus syndrome (Gorlin syndrome) is a distinct condition from Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC), with different clinical and genetic characteristics.
Gorlin Syndrome (Basal Cell Nevus Syndrome) is another term for Basal cell nevus syndrome, which is unrelated to the provided leaf ID B1.1.
